paper_metadata.title: Pure tungsten and oxide dispersion strengthened tungsten manufactured by selective laser melting: Microstructure and cracking mechanism

evidence.quote: The microstructure and cracking behavior of pure tungsten and micron- and nanosized Y 2O3 dispersion strengthened tungsten fabricated by selective laser melting are comparatively studied in this work.

The microstructure and cracking behavior of pure tungsten and micron- and nanosized Y 2O3 dispersion strengthened tungsten fabricated by selective laser melting are comparatively studied in this work.
The raw powders used in the experiment include spherical pure tungsten (15 45 μm, purity 99.9 %, Tekna Co. Ltd. Canada) prepared by plasma spheroidization

Spherical micron-Y2O3 and spherical pure tungsten was uniformly mixed by high-speed ball milling in argon (99.999 vol%) to prepare the pre-printed powder of μm-ODS-W for SLM process.

The above three kinds of powders were all processed using a Renishaw AM400 SLM system (Renishaw Plc, UK) equipped with a 400 W continuous Nd: YAG fiber laser and a laser beam diameter of 70 μm. The SLM process of all the above powder was carried out in a flowing argon atmosphere (purity 99.999 vol%), and the initial residual oxygen content in the chamber was less than 0.1 vol% to reduce the oxidation.
All SLMed specimens were cut from the substrate to the size of 5*5*5 mm3 by wire electrical discharge machining (EDM) after the fabrication.
